title: Chief Commissioner must exercise general superintendence
description: The Chief Commissioner has powers of general superintendence, direction and control

content.what: shall have powers of general superintendence, direction and control
conditions: in respect of all administrative matters of the Central Authority
limitations: may delegate such of his powers relating to administrative matters of the Central Authority, as he may think fit, to any Commissioner (including Commissioner of a regional office) or any other officer of the Central Authority
